### Latest platform test correction

All 36 failures in the d819d71 hosted Ubuntu job reached the explicitly Windows-only host-install backend. Success/recovery fixtures now require Windows; all 41 original test bodies remain unchanged. Two new Unix API/CLI tests require explicit refusal without mutation or private output. The two existing permission-precedence checks remain cross-platform. Runtime installer functions and guards are unchanged; Unix installation remains unavailable.

Local Windows validation: 159 Rust passed / 1 existing parent-spawned worker ignored; format/build/all-target Clippy `-D warnings`, Python 17, typecheck and TypeScript 260 / 3 skipped pass. Native inputs (752) and retained runtime inputs (754) stayed unchanged. Fresh hosted Unix execution is pending; no whole-native rerun is claimed. [Raw indexed evidence](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/a6bbe2c4d6cae58f6ce3118d0f0fdb34ff01ea34/docs/validation/integration-2026-10-19/host-install-platform/README.md). The separate local R8 WIP is excluded.

Combines native Code Intelligence 0.5 checkpoints `c5178b2` and `7b8eabb`
with guarded GitHub App workflows and the subsequent source-bound native
extensions. The retained TypeScript runtime stays at 0.3. This remains an active
draft integration; full STATUS/R1â€“R9 acceptance and release are open.

### Implemented behavior

- **Git and GitHub workflows:** bounded verified history capture and persistent
  jobs, closed-PR discussion observations, actual unmerged-index conflict pages,
  captured impact areas and authored owner candidates. Approved digest submission,
  authenticated native intake and receipt-qualified metadata queries retain
  explicit endpoint, source and principal permissions with unknown-send recovery.
- **Guarded changes:** checked saved-plan replay, captured directory moves,
  function/file usage checks and bounded dependency-aware deletion propagation.
  Python empty-suite replacement, function-valued sibling declarators and concrete
  class-method decorator ownership keep original byte evidence and separate
  verification, approval, application and conditional recovery.
- **Source and graph adapters:** explicit PostgreSQL catalog capture, received
  HTTP/arXiv source bodies and exact evidence; reviewed Neo4j/FalkorDB publication
  preserves directed parallel rows, immutable revisions and unknown-write recovery.
  Saved-plan feedback distinguishes planned results from execution and source truth.
- **Host and runtime integration:** receipt-owned Codex MCP configuration,
  portable projections, checked registry coordination, root/query-scope repairs,
  process-environment and cleanup fixes, bounded HTTP refusals and SQLite deadlines.
  Optional retained-provider compatibility keeps separately indexed qualifications.

Repository content remains data. Immutable snapshots, original UTF-8 bytes,
directed/parallel observations and explicit host authority remain fundamental.
Default retrieval starts no model or analyzed project code. Unsupported or
incomplete capabilities are reported explicitly.

### Current status reconciliation

R2/R3/R8 now distinguish implemented contracts from concrete missing behavior
and external acceptance. `docs/REMAINING_WORK.md` maps all nine areas. This delta
changes only documentation/tracker text:753 runtime inputs match the prior
baseline (579 raw,174 CRLF); inventory/historical ledgers and counters are
unchanged. Fresh Python17 passes; native/TypeScript suites are not rerun. The
behavioral results below retain their original source/binary boundaries.

### Latest checked mixed graph composition

Opaque composition consumes two to four independently source/response-replayed
parents and an exact ordered host-authored link review. Original parent-qualified
concept/observation namespaces, parallel/reverse/self provider rows, ordered
hyperedge slots and full nested typed source/receipt/accounting remain intact.
Labels/aliases create no merge or semantic identity. Host links retain separate
indices, unverified provenance and degree counts; traces follow them only when
explicitly selected. Hyperedge roles create no flow.

Library parents may come from different checked workspaces/history. The CLI
selects explicit jobs from one root Store and applies PDF worker permission per
parent, including combined PDF/Office graphs. Frozen queries survive both Store
losses. No provider, persistence, source write, JSON capability construction or
default eight-tool MCP schema change is added. Broader analytics, semantic
qualification, cross-workspace CLI admission and full R4 remain open.

Source `789d50bb0d9a72a3ab97a1cc9f7e8eab91493203`; runtime merge `6702727d303cf6088a8b03702cfc76fddc434ec3`.
Eight new default cases include owned Node/PDF setup, qualified identities,
original and authored multiedges/degrees, Unicode ambiguity, direction/depth0,
capacity/deadline/private input refusal, independent parent/endpoints, both Store
losses and actual PDF+Office CLI query without provider files. Initial test-only
Copy/Clone compilation failure executes no test groups; the next focused three
groups pass27/0/0. Scoped protocol/query evidence establishes no model-quality,
independent billing, semantic truth or current live workspace applicability.

### Validation

| Scope | Result |
| --- | --- |
|20 latest selected native groups|630 passed / 0 failed / 7 ignored; 752 inputs unchanged|
|Native quality|Format, build and all-target Clippy with warnings denied pass|
|Actual native execution|Owned Node/PDF protocol processes and CLI included in default scope; no real semantic model/paid-service billing qualification|
|Mandatory retained checks|Typecheck; 260 TypeScript tests / 3 existing skips; 17 Python tests pass|
|Prior behavioral integration|754 inputs unchanged; all 752 native inputs match exactly or only by CRLF checkout materialization|

Earlier TS/LSP CLI checkpoints hash their executable before/after use against
their own final build. The latest owned Node/PDF protocol processes are
covered by their unchanged source freeze; no separate before/after call-hash
or real-model quality attestation is claimed.
Counts from scoped, actual and historical runs overlap and are not additive.
Earlier provider/platform qualifications retain their own exact source/binary
boundaries; this is not a new whole-native or current-head hosted acceptance claim.

### Remaining boundaries

All 353 inventory identities, 73 unreconciled rows, 77 backend runtime unknowns and
false full-contract certifications remain. Other provider intents, clients,
language/file shapes, dynamic/external consumers, exhaustive compiler/runtime
guarantees and full upstream/IDE equivalence remain open. Historical OS1314
fixtures and hosted-platform failures remain indexed. Unattended production App
installation, wider authenticated/media services, full platform acceptance,
`main` integration and release are not certified by these scoped checks.
